To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

judiciously applying the join operation as reducers can reduce the communication cost required by distributed query processing, and that an efficient heuristic algorithm is developed to determine an effective set of join reducers.

the problem of selecting an effective sequence of reducers for a given query graph can be formulated as a problem of finding a set cuts to the graph, where a graph cut is a partition of its nodes, and an efficient heuristic algorithm for determining an effective sequence of reductions can be developed by exploiting the relationship between the two problems.

the problem of finding a sequence of join reducers to reduce the communication cost of distributed query processing can be mapped to that of finding cuts to the query graph and an efficient heuristic algorithm for finding cuts to the graph can be developed.

the problem of determining the sequence of join operations to be used as reducers in distributed database query processing.
the problem of reducing communication costs in distributed database processing, and our results can lead to further improvement in communication efficiency.
the use of join operations as reducers to reduce communication cost in distributed query processing.
